slides.title: Medical Excellence Sets the Standard for the Whole Team
bullets: Owns standards, training, tools and quality frameworks
Judged on whether the whole organisation performs consistently
A structurally different problem than an individual MSL's own quality

slides.title: Competency Frameworks and Training
bullets: Defines what "good" looks like in exchange, insights, compliance, engagement
Builds training curricula and certification programs
Designs SOPs and governance frameworks for compliant field activity

slides.title: Often Owns the CRM MSLs Use Every Day
bullets: Owns systems like Veeva for planning, insight capture, territory data
Consistent data quality depends on a well-designed, well-trained-on system
Not just individual diligence

slides.title: Audits, Calibration and Onboarding
bullets: Audits scientific interactions and materials
Runs calibration so different MSLs interpret compliance the same way
Identifies skill gaps from performance data, not anecdote
Often owns structured onboarding for new MSLs

slides.title: It Sets the Bar You're Measured Against
bullets: Defines the quality bar and builds the training you go through
Designs the tools that shape your day-to-day work
Understanding it turns compliance into something constructive

slides.title: A Natural Senior Route for Experienced MSLs
bullets: Lets you shape how an entire Medical Affairs organisation operates
Beyond managing just your own individual territory
Explored further in Module 12

takeaway.title: Medical Excellence builds the standards, training and tools that let the whole Medical Affairs organisation perform consistently
bullets: It owns competency frameworks, SOPs and often the CRM itself
Quality assurance runs on audits, calibration and performance data
It is also a genuine senior-career path for experienced MSLs
